mentions.name: Jynx
mentions.description: A social network for gamers on iOS and Android (web coming soon) that combines people-matching, community chat, and game-session scheduling, with the stated goals of helping with social isolation and helping e-sports teams source and organize players.
mentions.problem: Helps with social isolation among gamers and with e-sports teams' sourcing and organizing.
mentions.audience: Gamers looking for people to play with and e-sports teams sourcing and organizing players.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Social network for gamers (iOS/Android, soon web).

Tinder meets Discord and, somehow, they have their way with Uber/Calendly.

It's live if you want to test it:
https://jynx.app/

Let me know what you think of it.
The main goals I want to achieve are:
1. help with social isolation
2. help e-sport team with sourcing and organizing
